answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake and build a steady pulse of verified work before it can vote or claim rewards. A newcomer starts with no weight, so influence grows only through sustained history, not instant registration. Like water vanishing into karst, cheap fake identities drain away without a traceable record, while a participant must keep investing time, stake, and compute. Felling a timber forest to fake that history costs far more than the reward, so a Sybil attacker must pay linearly for each fake identity and risks slashing if any misbehaves.
